title: Sanitary Tees vs. Wye Fittings in Horizontal Drain Runs
description: Installing the wrong fitting in horizontal drainage lines is a common installation mistake that leads to frequent clogs and poor flow velocity. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from a horizontal branch into a vertical drainage stack. When installed horizontally, a sanitary tee lacks a gradual sweep, causing wastewater to lose momentum and solid waste to deposit at the junction. For horizontal-to-horizontal branch connections, professionals always install a combination wye and 1/8 bend to direct sewage smoothly in the direction of flow, preserving hydraulic velocity and preventing blockages.

Sanitary Tees vs. Wye Fittings in Horizontal Drain Runs

Installing the wrong fitting in horizontal drainage lines is a common installation mistake that leads to frequent clogs and poor flow velocity. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from a horizontal branch into a vertical drainage stack. When installed horizontally, a sanitary tee lacks a gradual sweep, causing wastewater to lose momentum and solid waste to deposit at the junction. For horizontal-to-horizontal branch connections, professionals always install a combination wye and 1/8 bend to direct sewage smoothly in the direction of flow, preserving hydraulic velocity and preventing blockages.
